sloka: आबध्य शरसम्पूर्णे इषुधी विमले तदा ।श्रोणिसूत्रं च खड्गं च विमलं कमलेक्षणः ॥
transliteration: ābadhya śarasampūrṇe iṣudhī vimale tadā ।śroṇisūtraṁ ca khaḍgaṁ ca vimalaṁ kamalekṣaṇaḥ ॥

translations.english: The Lord, having mounted the mountain-like Garuda, the son of Vinata, swiftly departed for the destruction of the Rakshasas.
